name: 360° Interior Progress Tracking & Walk Documentation
description: Conducting a structured 360° photographic capture of interior spaces at regular intervals, uploading to the Evercam platform, and enables remote stakeholders to navigate the virtual walk-through to inspect progress.

name: Automated Daily / Weekly Progress Photo Distribution
description: Automatically capturing a site progress photograph at a configured interval and distributing it to a defined list of stakeholders without any manual effort from site staff.

name: Remote Site Monitoring & Progress Checking
description: Checking live or recently recorded camera footage via the Evercam platform to assess manpower levels, confirm that scheduled activities are underway, identify any overnight or early morning incidents, and gather enough visual information to direct decisions without a site visit.

name: Schedule / Milestone Progress Verification
description: Reviewing Evercam footage, time-lapse, or snapshot comparisons against the planned programme to confirm whether work has progressed at the expected rate and build a contemporaneous visual record to support schedule-related claims.

name: Before / After Progress Documentation
description: Using Evercam's Compare tool to select and present two timestamped images from the same camera at different dates.

name: Concrete Pour & Structural Work Documentation
description: Capturing continuous timestamped visual record — pre-pour inspection through pouring to post-pour curing and formwork stripping.

name: Post-Project Close-Out & Handover Documentation
description: Compiling and packaging full visual record — time-lapses, 360° archives, drone outputs, milestone clips — into structured close-out deliverable for client.

name: Multi-Site / Portfolio-Level Remote Oversight
description: Accessing Evercam multi-project dashboard to review live feeds, recent time-lapses, and recorded footage across multiple sites.

name: Proactive Safety & PPE Compliance Monitoring
description: Using Evercam live view to remotely observe whether workers are wearing required PPE, following prescribed safe behaviours, and adhering to site safety rules.

name: Safety Incident Investigation & Post-Incident Review
description: Retrieving, reviewing, and preserving Evercam footage of the incident and the period leading up to it — to reconstruct what happened, identify contributing factors, and produce an evidence base for the formal investigation.

name: Crane & High-Risk Lift Monitoring
description: Using Evercam cameras to monitor crane lift operations in real time, verifying exclusion zone clearance and capturing a continuous timestamped video record.

name: Fire Investigation & Hot Work Safety Monitoring
description: Retrieving and analysing Evercam footage to reconstruct sequence of events — establishing when fire started, where it originated, who was working, and whether hot work permit was complied with.

name: High-Risk Zone & Restricted Area Monitoring
description: Maintaining continuous or regularly checked visual surveillance of restricted zones to detect unauthorised access, unsafe proximity, or exclusion boundary breach.

name: Safety Training & Lessons Learned Using Site Footage
description: Retrieving and editing Evercam footage of real site events to create training materials demonstrating consequences of unsafe practices.

name: Vehicle & Plant Safety Incident Investigation
description: Retrieving, reviewing, and analysing Evercam footage and Gate Report data to reconstruct the incident.

name: AI-Powered Safety Intelligence & SIF Detection
description: Automated AI analysis of live Evercam camera feeds to detect defined safety risk conditions and dispatch real-time alerts to designated safety personnel.

name: Delay, EOT & Weather Event Documentation for Claims
description: Assembling and packaging documented visual and meteorological evidence that links specific adverse conditions to specific periods of demonstrable site inactivity — for submission as a formal EOT or prolongation claim.

name: Delivery Verification & Material Quantity Reconciliation
description: Cross-referencing Gate Report vehicle entry/exit logs and camera recordings against paper delivery dockets and supplier invoices.

name: Dispute Resolution — Legal Evidence Retrieval & Formal Claims
description: Retrieving, preserving, and formally packaging Evercam footage and associated metadata as admissible evidence for use in legal proceedings.

name: Variation & Scope Change Claim Validation
description: Retrieving and reviewing historical Evercam footage to establish a factual visual record of what work was performed, when, and by whom.

name: Workers' Compensation & False Injury Claim Defence
description: Retrieving and reviewing Evercam footage to reconstruct the sequence of events before, during, and after the reported injury.

name: Stockpile, Earthworks & Volume Quantity Tracking
description: Using drone-captured photogrammetric surveys and/or fixed camera recordings to independently measure/estimate earthworks volumes and stockpile quantities.

name: After-Hours Security Monitoring & Intruder Detection
description: Reviewing Evercam footage from the relevant after-hours time window to establish what occurred, who was involved, when, and what was damaged or removed.

name: Gate Access Control & Vehicle Movement Monitoring
description: Automatically recording all vehicle entry and exit events at site gates using ANPR, generating structured gate reports that can be filtered, exported, and cross-referenced.

name: Material & Equipment Theft Investigation
description: Retrieving and reviewing Evercam footage — using time-lapse to rapidly narrow the theft window, then full recordings for detailed review — to identify what was taken, when, by whom, and by what means.

name: Access Control & User Permission Management
description: Configuring and maintaining user access permissions — adding/removing users, assigning roles, applying camera-level restrictions, setting access expiry.

name: Perimeter & Boundary Security Monitoring (Ongoing)
description: Continuous passive monitoring of site boundary — recording all perimeter movement, detecting/logging breach attempts, verifying hoarding integrity.

name: Material Storage & Inventory Area Monitoring
description: Using fixed camera surveillance of laydown areas, compounds, and material stores to monitor stock condition, verify quantities on-site, and detect unauthorised access, damage, or deterioration.

name: Subcontractor Invoice & Payment Dispute Resolution
description: Retrieving and reviewing Evercam footage and Gate Report records for the dates and locations relevant to the disputed claims — presenting that evidence to the subcontractor to resolve the dispute.

name: Subcontractor Labour & Attendance Verification
description: Accessing Evercam recordings for specific date(s) and time window(s) claimed by the subcontractor — reviewing footage to verify presence, number, arrival time, and departure time of workers.

name: Subcontractor Work Quality & Defect Verification
description: Reviewing Evercam footage and 360° captures to document the condition of subcontractor work — confirming quality compliance or identifying defects requiring remediation.

name: Pay Application / Progress Claim Visual Verification
description: Reviewing Evercam recordings and snapshots from the claim period to establish a visual baseline of work actually completed.

name: Subcontractor Plant & Equipment Utilisation Verification
description: Reviewing Evercam camera recordings and Gate Report data for relevant dates to establish actual mobilisation/utilisation/demobilisation timeline of specific plant items.

name: Union / Labour Compliance & Workforce Verification
description: Using camera footage and Gate Report data to verify that the workforce on site matches the agreed labour classifications, crew sizes, and production rates.

name: GDPR / Data Privacy Compliance for Camera Deployment
description: Establishing and documenting full legal/operational compliance framework — lawful basis, data subject notification, access controls, retention periods, subject access request procedures.

name: Noise, Community & Environmental Compliance Monitoring
description: Retrieving and reviewing timestamped camera recordings and Gate Report ANPR data to establish factual record of site activity relative to permitted conditions.

name: Noise & Operating Hours Compliance Monitoring
description: Reviewing timestamped camera recordings to establish the precise pattern of site activity relative to the permitted working hours window.

name: Regulatory / OSHA / HSE Investigation Support
description: Preserving, reviewing, and formally disclosing Evercam footage to the regulatory investigator.

name: Dig Permit & Underground Utility Clearance Documentation
description: Documenting through camera footage that permit-to-dig process steps — utility mark-out, CAT scan sweep, hand-dig trial holes, and pre-dig sign-off — were completed before any mechanical excavation commenced.

name: Sustainability & Environmental Impact Reporting
description: Extracting and integrating relevant Evercam data streams into the project's sustainability reporting or CO₂ accounting workflow.

name: Stakeholder & Owner Progress Reporting
description: Assembling and delivering a visual progress update — time-lapse video, automated snapshot sequences, live camera access, or curated footage clips — to owners, investors, design team members, or senior management.

name: Time-Lapse Production for Stakeholder Communication
description: Producing a complete, polished time-lapse video for distribution to investors, developers, government bodies, management boards, or the public as a standalone communication asset.

name: Weekly Progress Meeting Preparation & Presentation
description: Selecting, assembling, and presenting visual evidence of site progress to give remote stakeholders, owners, architects, and senior management an accurate picture of current site status.

name: Internal Staff Visibility & Intranet / Video Wall Integration
description: Configuring and maintaining regular internal communications channel through which Evercam footage is distributed to internal staff.

name: BIM vs. Reality Comparison & Design Verification
description: Comparing as-built site conditions directly against the BIM or design model to verify that structure, MEP installations, finishes, or sequence are correct — identifying deviations before they become costly defects.

name: RFI & Issue Logging with Visual Evidence
description: Capturing clear timestamped visual evidence of an issue and attaching it to a formal RFI/issue log.

name: Snagging / Punchlist Documentation
description: Systematically photographing, recording, and cataloguing defects/incomplete items across the completed building, producing a visual punchlist.

name: MEP Commissioning Verification
description: Using 360° capture walkthroughs and camera footage to document and verify the condition of MEP installations.

name: Smart Search / Object Detection for Operational Intelligence
description: Executing an AI-powered object detection search across stored camera footage to rapidly surface timestamped clips of a specified object, event type, or activity.

name: Social Media & Marketing Content Production
description: Generating a polished time-lapse or progress video clip that compresses weeks or months of construction into a compelling, shareable video asset suitable for direct publication on social media.

name: Client Handover & Completion Celebration Video
description: Compiling project time-lapse archive with milestone recordings, drone footage, and 360° capture into a structured completion video.

name: Tendering & Bid Preparation — Visual Portfolio
description: Curating and presenting visual portfolio content from completed projects to substantiate contractor's experience claims in tender or capability presentation.

name: Industry Event & Conference Content Production
description: Curating, editing, and presenting Evercam time-lapse footage as the centrepiece of a conference presentation, award entry video, or industry documentary.

name: Drone-Based Site Survey & Aerial Progress Capture
description: Conducting aerial drone survey, processing imagery into orthomosaic maps/point clouds, hosting output on Evercam platform for progress tracking and verification.

name: Drone / Media Platform Migration & Consolidation
description: Migrating drone survey outputs, aerial photography, and other site media from third-party platforms into the Evercam platform — and decommissioning or reducing reliance on legacy platform(s).

name: VR / Immersive Site Review
description: Loading a 360° or multi-camera site capture into a VR headset or immersive browser environment and conducting a simulated walkthrough of the site.

name: Weighbridge & Tipping Truck Workflow Monitoring
description: Cross-referencing camera-recorded truck arrival and departure events with weighbridge system records to verify that every claimed load is supported by a corresponding truck movement and valid weigh ticket.

name: Preconstruction & Planning
description: Workflows that use camera-based visual intelligence during the preconstruction and early mobilisation phases to document site conditions, plan logistics, and establish baselines.

name: Pre-Construction Baseline & Site Condition Documentation
description: Conducting systematic pre-construction condition survey — using 360° for interior/adjacent buildings, fixed cameras for external areas/boundaries, drone for aerial overview.

name: Logistics Planning & Site Layout Optimisation
description: Using wide-angle and elevated camera views to plan and validate site layout — including crane positions, laydown areas, access routes, and traffic flow — before and during early construction.
